Read `AGENTS.md` and the README before proposing changes.

LaraSaaS 3.x is a Laravel Composer library. Production plans are admin-managed database records; config defines only typed feature capabilities and display/integration settings. Do not confuse paid plan entitlements with Pennant rollout flags, or the Next.js demo with the package backend.

Keep pricing public, billing private, admin Gate-protected, and all embed writes signed. Preserve archived subscription price mappings. Ship one LaraSaaS baseline migration with all tables/columns directly defined; there is no legacy/additive upgrade path for the unused schema. Cashier customer columns live in that migration and must follow the configured user/workspace model's table (never hardcoded `users`) with `larasaas:doctor` alerting when the config changes after migrating; the installer skips Cashier's stock `create_customer_columns`. Workspaces/teams ship first-party tables, fixed Owner/Admin/Member roles with granular permissions and a single-owner invariant; workspace writes belong in `WorkspaceManager`. Never overwrite host migrations or seed demo plans. Native dashboards call createPlan/updatePlan/archivePlan after host authorization; the optional admin controller shares that validation. Embeds are customer-facing only. Run the PHP compatibility matrix and shipped React typecheck, and document breaking changes and migration steps.
